claim: A DOCUMENTED DEFECT RECURRED AND WAS GIVEN A MECHANISM. The control arms mutate RAW text while the rules compare WHITESPACE SQUASHED text, so an arm needle that straddles a line break cannot reach its site. CT-S42 recorded this as S42-07 and worked around it by hand-picking single-line needles; it recurred here on the first arm whose needle happened to wrap, reported as SKIPPED rather than MISSED. Repaired structurally: the arm substitution helper compiles its needle to a regex tolerating any run of whitespace wherever the needle has one. Arms went from 14 of 15 CAUGHT with one SKIPPED to 15 of 15 CAUGHT, with no change to any drafted file.
label: VERIFIED
review_note: a defect that recurs after being documented needs a mechanism rather than another note. The SKIPPED-not-MISSED distinction is what made the recurrence legible at all.
